name: cortico-world-streamvoice
description: 流式语音播报：订阅主 session 的输出增量，从台词参数里边生成边按句切块，第一块立刻合成播放，后面排队连播。合成引擎可切：微软 Edge 朗读接口，或任何 OpenAI 兼容的语音服务（只填根地址，模型与音色点一下就能探测出来）。音色、语速、念哪些内容、切块长度、块间停顿都是自己的配置，面板上可以逐个试听 / Streaming speech: chunks the line as it streams out of the model and speaks the first sentence before the reply is finished. The engine is switchable between Microsoft Edge and any OpenAI-compatible speech service (enter the base URL; voices and models are discovered by a built-in connection test).
author: xww

zh.description: 边生成边朗读：模型还在写，第一句已经出声。合成走 Edge 朗读接口，或任何 OpenAI 兼容的语音服务——只填根地址，点一次「连接测试」就能把后端支持的音色与模型拉出来直接选。音色、念什么、切块与停顿都在自己的配置页里，只显示当前引擎那一组，不依赖别的扩展。

en.description: Speaks the reply as it is written: the first sentence is heard before the model finishes. Synthesise through Microsoft Edge or any OpenAI-compatible speech service — enter the base URL and one connection test pulls the voices and models the backend offers. Only the active engine is shown, and nothing is read from other extensions.
